name: Active View Selection for 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: An active view selection (AVS) method that uses a single direction-dependent coverage feature map with max aggregation and dropped opacity to guide the selection of training views for 3D Gaussian Splatting.
summary: Active View Selection for 3D Gaussian Splatting identifies optimal training views using a single coverage feature map, avoiding the need for hold-out views or gradient boosting required by the full PRIMU method.
